Inquiry & booking-request forms routed to email/WhatsApp
Ready to plug into SafariBookings / TripAdvisor listings

addons.name: Extra page

notes: All prices are starting points — final quotes depend on page count, features, content readiness, and integrations.
A deposit (commonly 50%) is typically requested to begin work, with the balance due on delivery.
Domain and hosting are billed separately at cost unless bundled into the package.
Revisions beyond the included rounds are billed at an agreed hourly or per-change rate.
Prices exclude third-party costs (premium plugins, stock photography, paid ad accounts) unless stated otherwise.
